name: @tradrl/execution-authority
description: Execution-authority contracts (Work Order T040): the versioned content-addressed AuthorityGrantRecord (who may do what — principal, order kinds, venues, rate budgets, opaque credential bindings, explicit validity window, revocation log), the Default-Deny EntitlementRegistry with typed EntitlementRefusal predicates (unknown venue, unknown grant, missing entitlement — nothing routes by default), the credential-opacity trip-wire run over EVERY emitted record (a credential VALUE anywhere is the typed credential_value_present error — SECURITY.md's boundary enforced in code), the RoutingTable (venue/instrument -> opaque adapter/channel refs over the T039 descriptors), the GatewayOrderRequest translation contract (an order request without a valid APPROVED decision is INEXPRESSIBLE at the guard level), and the chain-verified GatewayAuditRecord trail carrying SECURITY.md's audit contents (who/what, BodyVersion, substrate, policy, visible state, risk checks, order, execution, outcome).
